task_title: Add automatic schedule summary and reminder system
summary: Implemented automatic schedule summary and reminder system. Created O1/core/scheduler.py with ScheduleReminder class that provides morning daily briefings at 08:00 (configurable) using Claude summarization, and per-event reminders every 5 minutes for events within the next 15 minutes. Added get_events_as_list() method to MacCalendar that returns structured event data with datetime objects for programmatic time comparison. Integrated the scheduler into main.py with proper lifecycle management (daemon threads, start/stop), and added voice command detection for on-demand schedule summaries via keywords like '일정 요약', '오늘 일정', 'schedule summary', and 'daily briefing'.
demo_script: Sir, I've implemented an automatic schedule summary and reminder system. Every morning at 8 AM, I'll give you a briefing of your day's events. I'll also check every 5 minutes for upcoming events and remind you 15 minutes before they start. You can also say 'schedule summary' or '오늘 일정' anytime for an on-demand overview of your day.

changes.description: Added get_events_as_list() method that returns structured event data (title, start_time, end_time, location as dicts). Added _parse_time_string() and _parse_single_time() helpers to convert icalBuddy time strings to datetime objects. Enhanced _parse_events_list to catch time lines without 'at' prefix.

Created new scheduler module with ScheduleReminder class. Implements morning daily briefing (default 08:00) via Claude summarization and per-event reminders every 5 minutes for events within 15 minutes. Uses threading.Timer loop with daemon threads. Tracks reminded events by (title, start_time) set to avoid duplicates.

Integrated ScheduleReminder into OrionO1 lifecycle. Added import, instantiation after calendar/tts/brain init, start() in run(), stop() in finally block. Added schedule summary voice command detection for '일정 요약', '오늘 일정', 'schedule summary', 'daily briefing' keywords. Added SCHEDULE_SUMMARY_KEYWORDS constant and _is_schedule_summary_command() method.
